title: Outreach, in the moment
question: Someone opens Outreach because they have time now. Outreach days are a time window, not a place: a walk from home during it still counts. Each sketch shows Saturday 9:05, outreach on, walker at home. Which should lead?

options.label: Three quick steps
options.thesis: Time, then start, then your route: three short steps with big answers, ending on a route card ready to walk.
options.viewport: A banner that outreach is on until 11:30 and your walk counts; step 1 of 3 'How long have you got?' with four large tiles; start options below; Next.
options.risk: Three steps is a tap or two more than the fastest path, though each step is trivial.

options.label: Routes near you
options.thesis: Ready-made routes around where you are, one per screen with its map; swipe through, tap Go. Today's outreach routes sit in the same deck with who's claimed them.
options.viewport: One big card: the loop on a map, '1 hr from your door · 104 letterboxes · 2 bundles', Go; a peek of the next card; an outreach chip on routes that belong to today's outreach.
options.risk: You browse rather than ask for exactly the time you have, so the right length may be a few swipes away.

options.label: Go now
options.thesis: One screen: how long have you got, from where you are, and the loop is already drawn; change the time and it redraws; Start.
options.viewport: Masthead with the outreach-on note; big time chips; a map preview of the loop from your location; letterboxes and bundles; Start walk; patches and today's routes as quieter links below.
options.risk: Everything on one screen means patches and outreach routes get less room.
